text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali reaffirmed to newly named Foreign Affairs Minister Zouari that fundamentals of Tunisia's foreign policy had not changed.
- Zouari to pay a visit to Germany at the end of this week for talks with his German counterpart Klaus Kinkel.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui met Spanish businessmen on the second day of his visit to Madrid.
